periods.time: As Stella is near collapse against Xiaoli

name.zh: 一辉阻止比翼救援并选择相信史黛菈
name.en: Ikki Stops Edelweiss and Chooses to Trust Stella

periods.summary: When Stella loses consciousness but continues fighting Xiaoli, Tatara tries to intervene and is punished by Rule of Graces. Edelweiss then moves to rescue Stella herself, but Ikki blocks her with Intetsu. He declares that Stella is not merely seeking death but fighting to preserve an unyielding self, and that he swore to protect her chance to believe in herself. Despite exhaustion, he uses compressed point magic defense learned from Edelweiss to stop one of her blades and briefly repel the world's strongest swordswoman.
periods.cause: Edelweiss believes Stella will die if no one intervenes, while Ikki believes stopping her before she gives up would betray her oath and selfhood.
periods.process: Ikki explains Stella's request to 'let me believe in myself,' invokes his own Worst One identity, and uses predicted sword paths plus minimal magic concentration to block Edelweiss's strike.
periods.outcome: Edelweiss is delayed long enough for Stella's final awakening; Ikki's trust is vindicated when Stella rises again.
periods.significance: Clarifies Stella's battle as self-affirmation rather than suicide and demonstrates Ikki's growth from Edelweiss's training.
